nodes.name: Every Night at 03:15
nodes.notes: Workflow time zone is Europe/Warsaw (Settings). Does nothing for agencies without a retention period (Settings → ai_config.retention_months).

parameters.query:
-- 0051: erase clients with no activity for longer than their agency's
-- retention period (agencies without one are skipped), and Elliot's own
-- website enquiries past the sales account's period. Returns the stored
-- files to delete next. retention_preview() shows who would go.
select apply_retention(200) as result,
       (select supabase_url from platform_settings limit 1) as supabase_url;

nodes.name: Delete Files
nodes.notes: Supabase Storage, private bucket email-attachments. Deleting is safe to repeat.

meta.description: 0051: nightly, erases clients past their agency's retention period and deletes their stored files. Does nothing until a retention period is set.
